calibration.summary: Oregon official 2026 fifth-year receiver who missed 2025 through injury and utilized medical redshirt. 2024 All-Big Ten honorable mention with 48 catches/613 yards/5 TD. Meaningful bounce-back upside exists after injury but no 2025 game sample, so higher downside volatility than a fully healthy veteran; normal five-year period concludes 2026.

Oregon junior corner appeared in all 15 games and made 12 starts as a redshirt freshman in 2025, recording 24 tackles, six pass breakups, one interception and 423 defensive snaps. This is meaningful coverage responsibility even with modest tackle totals; a modest Year 2 leap is more plausible than a giant breakout or a class-based automatic decline. Redshirt freshman 2025 after 2024 matriculation yields draft eligibility in 2027.

Oregon senior TE and Louisville transfer made 10 starts in 15 games in 2025, catching 32 passes for 510 yards and three TD, sixth in school TE single-season yardage. Previous Louisville redshirt-sophomore 2024 produced 13 catches for 158 yards and a TD before injury. Proven receiving growth, 600 snaps and 78.2 PFF overall grade in 2025 substantiate value, but senior size/role limits repeat breakout likelihood; exact remaining college eligibility unverified.

Oregon junior receiver emerged as a 2025 redshirt freshman with 38 receptions for 557 yards and three TD across 15 games and nine starts; started final eight games and played 520 offensive snaps, 71.8 PFF overall in school bio. Can expand targets and role in 2026–27 yet 2025 evidence proves him more than an unused reserve. 2024 initial enrollment permits 2027 draft but modest established production means declaration far from certain.

Oregon 2026 true sophomore RB was 2025 All-Big Ten honorable mention after 14 games, one start and 113 carries for 667 yards with team-leading 15 rushing TD. Red-zone skill is demonstrated, but limited 2025 starting volume and 2026 expanding role support meaningful development and some college variance. First matriculated in 2025, so not 2027 NFL eligible.

calibration.summary: Third-year Texas receiver transferred from Stanford in 2025. Stanford 2024 true freshman: 48 receptions for 525 yards, six TD and freshman school records; 2025 Texas nine games/eight starts with touchdowns and postseason catches. In 2026 first four games: three for 37, five for 67, three for 28, and one for 43 yards. Upside from full-season role vs established prior production, not an unproven prospect.

Texas second-year sophomore defensive back with 11 starts in 17 career appearances through early 2026, eight-tackle career high in 2025 and three INT career total through September 2026. Started three of first four 2026 games including an interception and pass breakup against Ohio State and 59-yard fumble return TD vs Texas State. Proven playmaking in substantial young workload; no 2027 NFL draft under 2025 matriculation.

Official Texas 2026 fifth-year interior DL after Ohio State; 43 career games/15 Texas starts and Phil Steele preseason All-SEC nod. Started all four games with 1.5 TFL against Texas State and 1.5 sacks at Tennessee. Established 2025–26 starter value with ordinary steady probability and modest further growth. 2022 matriculation implies normal fifth-year eligibility ends after 2026 unless waiver.

Texas 2026 senior RB transfer from NC State, 2025 career highs of 24 rushes/164 yards at Wake Forest and 65-yard carry at Pittsburgh. In 2026 scored twice against Ohio State and a receiving touchdown against Texas State while sharing backfield. Demonstrated multiyear burst and receiving utility, new-school role uncertainty; senior is fourth college year, not confirmed exhausted.

Texas official senior DB played 43 career games/21 starts heading into 2026; 2025 started all 13 games with interceptions against UTEP, Sam Houston and Arkansas and 14 tackles at Mississippi State. 2026 started all first four and registered 8/7/3/8 tackles against Texas State, Ohio State, UTSA and Tennessee. High current workload supports stable/solid gains but no giant ceiling leap.

Texas 2026 senior LB transferred from Florida State where he led LBs with 43 tackles, five TFL and a sack in 2025, eight starts. In Texas first four games started all, recorded nine tackles vs Ohio State and nine at Tennessee with pressure/PBU production. Starting consistency supports moderate improvement with normal new-scheme volatility, not automatic 2026 graduation from fourth-year class.

Texas sophomore corner/safety played 16 games with seven starts early in 2026. His 2025 highs include eight solo stops and two TFL vs Michigan and two PBUs vs Arkansas. Demonstrated rookie defensive responsibility, but more technique consistency and expanded role possible. 2025 college enrollment makes 2027 NFL Draft ineligible.

Texas junior defensive back entered college 2024, appeared in 30 career games with only four starts by October 2026. First 2025 college interception came against Texas A&M, three starts in first part of 2026 with pass breakup against Texas State. Increased 2026 role makes real improvement possible, but modest established starts temper NFL declaration probability.

Texas third-year defensive tackle transferred from Syracuse, where he had 11 starts in 13 freshman games; played 12 games/six starts for Texas in 2025 with 1.5 sacks vs San José State. Started all four 2026 games with strip-sack vs Texas State and five tackles/TFL at Tennessee. Established multi-school interior snaps suggest steady to modest upward course.

Texas official 2026 fifth-year RB transferred from Arizona State after starting career at USC; 33 career games across three schools. ASU 2025 career 255 rushing yards at Colorado, then Texas first four 2026 games 48 rushes for 205 yards/four TD, team-leading 67 yards and two TD at Tennessee. Real burst but recurrent transfers/injury history and capped fifth-year eligibility raise volatility. Must exit normally after 2026.
